t: Gangs and Children
s: Gangs are groups of children, adolescents and young adults who share a common identity and are involved in wrongful or delinquent activities. Most gang members tend to be adolescents or young adults, however, recent trends indicate that children are being recruited into gangs at a much earlier age, some when they are in elementary school.

t: gang - Students | Britannica Kids | Homework Help
s: Gangs normally originate in poor neighborhoods, where the chances of legitimate success in life may seem out of reach. Young people in such neighborhoods often face social and economic disadvantages that push them toward gang life. Gang members are more likely than other youths to come from broken homes and to perform poorly in school.
